figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

M01.note: Inherited from the LRS3 / VoxCeleb2 pipeline.

choice: Joint audio-teacher latents; ASR pseudo-labels in self-training
M02.field: Distillation from an audio or speech model (5 of 9 prior)
M02.note: Same audio pseudo-labelling route as AV-HuBERT on the same data: 7.7 against 3.9 points; pseudo-label decoding not stated.

choice: Asymmetric cross-modal prediction of momentum-teacher latents
M03.field: Contrastive objectives (3 of 7 prior); none with a momentum teacher
M03.note: Cross-modal asymmetric use of data2vec-style momentum teachers; ties AV-HuBERT at Large, 30 h (32.5%); ablations Base only, no repeat runs.

choice: Grayscale mouth ROI, 25 fps; raw 16 kHz audio
M05.note: Inherited; raw waveform instead of filterbanks is a minor departure.

M06.note: Inherited from the ESPnet / Ma et al. lineage.

M07.note: Inherited; selected weight not stated in the paper (public script: 0.3).

choice: LRS3 and LRS2 public test sets
M11.note: VoxCeleb2 speaker overlap with the LRS3 test set not discussed.

choice: LRS3 test WER, single runs, no seeds
M12.field: No run spread (15 of 20 prior LRS3 systems)
M12.note: Typical of the field; the same group reported ten-run spread earlier; abstract picks 25.9% over the 19.3% in its own table.
